array.string:
DISK_USAGE=$(df -h / | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}' | tr -d '%') RAM_PRESSURE=$(memory_pressure 2>/dev/null | grep "System-wide" | awk '{print $NF}') OLLAMA_OK=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:11434/api/tags 2>/dev/null) GW_OK=$(pgrep -f openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "running" || echo "stopped")
echo "$(date) | Disk: ${DISK_USAGE}% | RAM: ${RAM_PRESSURE:-unknown} | Ollama: ${OLLAMA_OK} | Gateway: ${GW_OK}" >> /tmp/openclaw-health.log
# Alert if disk > 90% if [ "$DISK_USAGE" -gt 90 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "$(date) ALERT: Disk usage at ${DISK_USAGE}%!" >> /tmp/openclaw-health.log fi
